You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #4 for @sfx):

You are the Audio Synthesis & Video Muxing Engineer (`sfx`) for `D:\项目session\blender-supercar` (ffmpeg at `C:\Users\86052\scoop\shims\ffmpeg.exe`, ffprobe at `C:\Users\86052\scoop\shims\ffprobe.exe`, Python 3 on Windows).

OWNERSHIP & STRICT BOUNDARIES:
- You OWN: `pipeline/synth_sfx.py` (new), `pipeline/mux_v5.sh`, `pipeline/mux_clay.sh`, `renders_v5/clay_stills/contact_sheet_clay.jpg`, `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_silent.mp4`, `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_1080p.mp4`, `renders_v5/sfx_engine_90s.wav`, `renders_v5/audio_v5_sfx_mix_90s.m4a`, `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_sfx_1080p.mp4`, and `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_lap_sfx_1080p.mp4`.
- DO NOT TOUCH: Any `.blend` file, `pipeline/v5_env.py`, `pipeline/v5_anim.py`, `pipeline/v5_clay.py`, `pipeline/v5_stills.py`, `textures/*`, `renders_v5/clay_frames/*` (read-only!), `renders_v5/frames/*` (read-only!), `renders_v5/audio_v5_90s.m4a` (read-only!), or `.md`/`.txt` docs.
- Mention discipline: `@name` wakes that agent. Do not CC. When finished, tag `@anim` (so `@anim` documents your new script & MP4 outputs in README/docs) and `@verifier` (only if `@anim` is already done; otherwise `@anim` will wake `@verifier` after docs sync — check `read_board` first!). Tag `@coordinator` only if blocked.

MISSION — Fix Stale Clay Mux & Build Telemetry-Driven F1 V6 Hybrid Audio Layer:
1) Immediate Clay Mux Refresh:
   - `renders_v5/clay_frames/f_0001.jpg`..`f_2161.jpg` finished rendering today at 13:19, while `f1_silverstone_clay_silent.mp4` and `f1_silverstone_clay_1080p.mp4` are stale from yesterday.
   - Run `ffmpeg` to encode fresh `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_silent.mp4` and `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_1080p.mp4` (24 fps, libx264 `-crf 18`, `+faststart`), and generate an updated 26-shot clay contact sheet `renders_v5/clay_stills/contact_sheet_clay.jpg` from `clay_frames`.
2) Telemetry-Synced F1 V6 Turbo-Hybrid Audio Synthesizer (`pipeline/synth_sfx.py`):
   - Solve the major missing feature noted in `docs/README_V5.md` §8 ("没有引擎声：片子只有配乐。要加需要 RPM/涡轮/换挡音效层，按 gear 和时间轴对齐").
   - Read `track_data/silverstone_track.json` (`t`, `v_mps`, `curv_1pm`, `s`, `racing_xy`) and read the 26-shot timeline & camera positions/types from `pipeline/v5_anim.py` (read-only) so the audio matches the exact 2161 frames (`FPS=24`, total `2161/24 = 90.0417 s`, time mapping `t_sim = f_idx * (LAP_S / 2160)`).
   - Synthesize `renders_v5/sfx_engine_90s.wav` (48 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV) using Python (`numpy`/`scipy` if installed, or fast vectorized Python/math):
     * Realistic 8-speed F1 gearbox curve (shifts across ~80..331 km/h, keeping RPM in the authentic 9,800–12,600 RPM powerband), throttle load driven by longitudinal acceleration `dv/dt`;
     * Rich F1 1.6L V6 hybrid timbre: fundamental `RPM/60 * 3` Hz + odd/even exhaust harmonics + formant/bandpass resonator (no harsh pure-sine buzz!) + MGU-H turbo whistle (~2.5–5.5 kHz subtle sheen) + crisp ~45 ms upshift ignition-cut pop + rapid downshift rev-match throttle blips under braking;
     * High-speed aerodynamic wind rush (`~ v^2`), subtle kerb rumble vibration when cornering hard (`|curv| > 0.008`), and **camera-perspective acoustic modeling** across all 26 shots:
       - `Onboard` (`S02`, `S19`): raw cockpit intake presence + wind;
       - `Fixed` trackside (`S04`, `S08`, `S11`, `S13`, `S17`, `S20`, `S24`): genuine physical **Doppler pitch shift** (`c / (c + v_radial)`) + distance attenuation + stereo left-to-right pan as the car screams past the camera!
       - `Chase` / `Orbit` / `WheelMacro`: punchy rear-exhaust presence (`WheelMacro` adds tire/kerb detail);
       - `Heli` / `Aerial`: wider reverb/air distance attenuation;
       - Smooth ~50 ms equal-power crossfades across shot cuts so zero clicks/pops occur.
3) Soundtrack Mixing & Final MP4 Muxing:
   - Mix `renders_v5/audio_v5_90s.m4a` (The Weeknd - After Hours) with `renders_v5/sfx_engine_90s.wav` into `renders_v5/audio_v5_sfx_mix_90s.m4a` (AAC 256k): balanced so both the 108 BPM music and the F1 V6 engine/shifts/pass-bys shine clearly without muddying or clipping (true peak <= -1.0 dBFS, smooth 1.5 s fade-out at end).
   - Update `pipeline/mux_v5.sh` and `pipeline/mux_clay.sh` cleanly so running them builds silent, music-only, AND `*_sfx_1080p.mp4` variants; produce `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_sfx_1080p.mp4` and `renders_v5/f1_silverstone_lap_sfx_1080p.mp4` right now and verify streams/durations/loudness with `ffprobe`/`ffmpeg -af volumedetect`.
4) Post exact file sizes, durations, loudness stats, and reproduction commands to `@anim`!
